SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch Station
REPORT
File No. 6712
17 - 8 - 36
Date August 17, 1936.

Subject N. V. Morozoff-Shivereff.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by J Boyu D S I

Diligent enquiries have failed to locate the present
whereabouts of N. V. Morozoff-Shivereff, Russian, who forms
the subject of the attached file (D.6712). It is reported
that he left Shanghai either for Tientsin or Hankow. Some
time prior to his departure he sent to D.S. Kourjansky a chit
(vide attached translation) to the effect that he had no
documents in his possession relating to the Russian Orthodox
Confraternity.

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

FILE
J.R.

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

报告
档案号 6712
17 - 8 - 36
日期：1936年8月17日。

事由：N. V. Morozoff-Shivereff。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 撰写，经 J Boyu D S I 转呈

经勤勉查访，未能查明附件档案（D.6712）所涉俄国人 N. V. Morozoff-Shivereff 的当前下落。据报，他已离开上海，前往天津或汉口。在离沪前的一段时间，他曾向 D.S. Kourjansky 发送一张便条（见附译文），称其手中并无任何与俄罗斯东正教兄弟会有关的文件。

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

归档
J.R.

D.C.（刑事及特务科）

Date 25-11-35

Shanghai, November 22nd 1935.

K.M.Bourne, Esq.
Acting Commissioner of Police

Dear Sir,

I am in receipt of your letter of November
20th, 1935, on the subject of unauthorised col-
lection of money by N.V.Shivereff, as well as
of three certificates, issued one in 1933 and two
in 1934.

I beg to inform you that this man still has
a certificate issued by me personally about nine
years ago, and as it is the most important one I
shall appreciate it very much if you could find
it possible to obtain it too.

Yours truly,

Superintendent of the
Hospital.
D.S. Tcheremohovsky.
D.S.R. 25/11

D.C. (Special Branch).
[Signature]
25 NOV. 1935

(印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 25 NOV. 1935)

S2.
For further action on the
lines indicated. [Signature]
25 NOV. 1935

S. 2, Special Branch, SERIOUS
REPORT
Date. November 18, 1935.
Subject N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff - Further report.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature] D.I.
Shevireff-Morosoff was located by D.S. Kourjansky
at Chapei where he has no permanent abode and is sleeping in
different Chinese lodging houses. He is engaged in peddling
flowers near the entrances of amusement resorts on Jukong Road.
Shevireff-Morosoff promised D.S. Kourjansky that he would bring
all the documents issued to him by the Russian Orthodox
Confraternity Hospital but failed to do so until after D.S.
Kourjansky's departure on short leave. The documents concerned
and attached herewith are:
1. Certificate in Russian that N.V. Shevireff was a
patient at the Hospital of the Russian Orthodox Confraternity
from April 16 until May 29, 1933 issued by Nurse on duty
E. Kesselman on May 29, 1933.
2. Certificate in English that N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff
was a patient at the Hospital of the Russian Orthodox Confraternity
from June 4 to July 16, 1934 issued by Matron G. Belorookoff
on July 16, 1934.
3. Similar certificate in English and Russian issued by
Matron G. Belorookoff on July 16, 1934.
[Signature]
D. S.
S2
D. C. (Special Branch). Is Shevireff - Morosoff
agreeable to have the certificates
sent to Dr Kasakoff ? [Initials]
19 NOV 1935
D.C / Special Branch /
N V Shevireff - Morosoff has no
objection to the certificates
being sent to Dr. D. Kasakoff
G. Tcheremshansky
20. 11. 35. [Signature] 20/11 DS.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 6712
10 - 11 - 35
特务科第二股，严重
报告
日期：1935年11月18日。
事由：N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff - 后续报告。
由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 撰写。经 [签名] D.I. 转呈
Shevireff-Morosoff 被 D.S. Kourjansky 在闸北找到，他在该处无固定住所，睡在不同的中式寄宿舍内。他从事在兆丰公园路（Jukong Road）游乐场所入口附近兜售花卉的工作。Shevireff-Morosoff 曾向 D.S. Kourjansky 承诺将带来俄罗斯东正教兄弟会医院签发予他的所有文件，但在 D.S. Kourjansky 短期休假离开后仍未履行。相关文件附呈如下：
1. 俄文证明书，证明 N.V. Shevireff 于1933年4月16日至5月29日期间在俄罗斯东正教兄弟会医院接受治疗，由值班护士 E. Kesselman 于1933年5月29日签发。
2. 英文证明书，证明 N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff 于1934年6月4日至7月16日期间在俄罗斯东正教兄弟会医院接受治疗，由护士长 G. Belorookoff 于1934年7月16日签发。
3. 类似的英俄文证明书，由护士长 G. Belorookoff 于1934年7月16日签发。
[签名]
D. S.
S2
D. C.（特务科）。Shevireff - Morosoff 是否同意将证明书寄给 Kasakoff 博士？[缩写签名]
1935年11月19日
D.C / 特务科 /
N V Shevireff - Morosoff 不反对将证明书寄给 D. Kasakoff 博士
G. Tcheremshansky
1935年11月20日 [签名] 20/11 DS.

pages.en:
As a result of further enquiries,the undersigned located
Shevireff -Morosoff on the 12-II-35 in the vicinity of N.Szechuen and
Jukong rds,and he promised to search for the documents in question
and bring them along to the Police on the 13-II-35. He however,
has failed to put in an appearance.

D.S.Kourjansky
pages.zh:
经进一步查访，具名人在1935年2月12日于四川北路和兆丰公园路（Jukong rds）附近找到了 Shevireff-Morosoff，他承诺寻找相关文件并于1935年2月13日带至警局。然而，他并未露面。

D.S. Kourjansky

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

S. 2, Special Branch. Suptax
REPORT
Date October 30, 19 35.
Subject Attached letter from the Russian Orthodox Confraternity
Hospital.
Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by D S J Boyne
Enquiries made by the undersigned with a view to
locating Mr. N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff, resulted in the information
that the latter has been in the habit of sleeping in one of
Chinese lodging houses on North Chekiang Road, near the North
Railway Station.
Several lodging houses in the above locality were
visited by the undersigned and C.D.S. 155 on the 29.10.35,
but the wanted man could not be located. He is known to one
of informers of the undersigned, who was instructed to trace
his present whereabouts.
A further report will be submitted in due course
upon him being located and interrogated.
D. S. Kourjansky
D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch).

日期 1935年10月30日。
事由：附俄罗斯东正教兄弟会医院来信。
由 D.S. Kourjansky 撰写。经 D S J Boyne 转呈
具名人为查找 N.V. Shevireff-Morosoff 先生进行的查访，获悉后者惯常在北火车站附近的浙江北路的一家中式寄宿舍过夜。
1935年10月29日，具名人及刑事侦缉警员 155 号走访了上述地区的几家寄宿舍，但未能找到被通缉者。具名人的线人之一认识此人，已指示该线人追踪其当前下落。
待找到此人并进行讯问后，将适时提交进一步报告。
D. S. Kourjansky
D. S.
D. C.（特务科）。

S. MUNICIPAL POLICE

No. D 6712
Date 14 / 5 / 35

Shanghai, May 11th, 1935

The Commissioner of Police Force.

Dear Sir,

（批：*No previous record in S.P. Br. Reg. Ju. 13/-）

I beg to inform you that a certain mr N.V.Morosoff-Shevireff is collecting money for an artificial leg, showing to people a document signed by me.

The document in question has been given him not to collect money, but as a certificate that he has been under treatment at our Hospital.

As I consider that Mr Morosoff has abused of our confidence and is using illegally the document in question, I have the honour to ask you to give orders to take away from Mr. Morosoff the document in question.

Yours truly,
[签名]

上海市警察局

编号 D 6712
日期 14 / 5 / 35

上海，1935年5月11日

警务处处长。

尊敬的先生：

（批注：*特务科登记处此前无记录。Ju. 13/-）

谨此告知，某位 N.V. Morosoff-Shevireff 先生正在展示一份由我签署的文件，以此向人们募集资金用于安装假肢。

该文件发给他的目的并非为了募集资金，而是作为他在我院接受治疗的证明。

鉴于我认为 Morosoff 先生滥用了我们的信任，并非法使用该文件，荣幸地请求您下令从 Morosoff 先生处收回该文件。

此致，
[签名]

S2，请留意。
[签名]
（印：1935年4月12日）
